tasks.short: Work with a client to identify financial goals and paths toward them.

steps.what: Prepare the client's known loans, income, commitments and recent contact history for the meeting
Explore the client's goals, constraints, priorities and concerns in a financial conversation
Draft practical next steps and record what the client chose to consider

loop.input: meeting notes, approved product terms and agreed priorities
loop.output: plain-language next-step note with stated assumptions
loop.check: the officer checks that it reflects the client's words, approved terms and any limits of the conversation
loop.stop: stop when the client needs regulated advice, a material suitability judgement or information not in the record; arrange a specialist conversation
loop.why_not_simpler: The note follows a structure but goals and personal constraints are expressed in the client's own words.

tasks.design: A {CRM} meeting brief gathers known facts and open questions before the conversation. The loan officer leads the goal-setting conversation; a bounded drafting step prepares a source-linked follow-up note rather than choosing a product for the client.
tasks.previous_blocker: The officer assembles the same client facts before each conversation and rewrites meeting notes afterward.
tasks.enabler_now: A case view can assemble factual context and a bounded draft can turn chosen priorities into a readable note.
tasks.still_hard: Goals, trade-offs and whether a client needs specialist advice are personal and accountable judgements.
tasks.human_edge: The officer can hear uncertainty, challenge an assumption gently and agree a realistic next step with the client.

ambition.what: Offer a documented goals conversation to clients whose existing loan situation has changed.

tasks.altitude: The officer looks for repeated client needs and improves the meeting guide instead of compiling background facts.

reach.task: Recognise when a goal discussion has become a broader financial-planning need
reach.learn: State the boundary between product information and specialist advice.

evidence.claim: A bounded drafting step can prepare a reviewable financial document, while a person retains responsibility.

assumptions: The boundary starts with preparation for a client conversation and ends with a factual follow-up note, not a lending or investment decision.
The meeting contract contains client ID, stated goal, constraint, priority, existing commitment, follow-up action, source-term version and owner; the client and officer supply the fields.
A missing fact remains an open question rather than being inferred from a prior case.
Native CRM timeline and note templates are tested before custom drafting.
One hour per 100 focal-role baseline hours is allowed for reviewing the meeting guide and draft exceptions.
unknowns: Which conversations require a licensed adviser or another specialist.
Whether clients consent to reuse prior loan evidence in a goals discussion.
research_questions: Which goals recur most often across loan customers?
How often does a goals conversation lead to a referral rather than a loan application?

already_counted.description: Officer review of the drafted follow-up note

incremental.description: Review meeting-guide changes and draft exceptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The conversation remains the main work; one upkeep hour per 100 baseline hours is deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Handle a customer complaint and take appropriate action to resolve it.

steps.what: Receive the complaint, identify the account and acknowledge the customer

loop.input: customer complaint message and account context
loop.output: complaint category, urgency and acknowledgement draft
loop.check: the officer checks identity, urgency, tone and whether the complaint contains a protected escalation trigger
loop.stop: stop on a vulnerable customer signal, legal threat, fraud concern or unclear account match; route to the complaint owner
loop.why_not_simpler: Customers describe the same service failure in different language and a complaint may be sensitive.

steps.what: Reconstruct what happened from the account, application, payment and contact records

loop.input: dated case events, messages and documents
loop.output: ordered complaint timeline with source links and gaps
loop.check: the officer checks the timeline against the original records before using it with the customer
loop.stop: stop on missing records, a disputed event or conflicting customer identity; investigate manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Events can be ordered deterministically but their relevance and the customer's account require judgement.

steps.what: Speak with the customer, explain findings and agree an appropriate remedy or escalation
Record the outcome, assign corrective work and close or escalate the complaint

tasks.design: A {CRM} complaint flow identifies the account, creates an evidence timeline and records the outcome. It can draft acknowledgement and assemble facts, but the loan officer owns the conversation, remedy and escalation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Complaint details are spread across calls, mailbox messages and case records before an officer can respond.
tasks.enabler_now: A case workflow can join dated records and create an accountable complaint trail.
tasks.still_hard: A fair remedy, tone and escalation path depend on what the customer experienced and the materiality of the failure.
tasks.human_edge: The officer can listen, apologise where appropriate and adapt the response to a distressed or confused customer.

ambition.what: Give every complaint a source-linked timeline and named corrective action, not just a response message.

tasks.altitude: The officer spots recurring service failures and proposes corrective work instead of repeatedly reconstructing cases.

reach.task: Triage a complaint and recognise escalation triggers
reach.learn: Use a complaint taxonomy and a source-linked timeline.

evidence.claim: A bounded review can structure untrusted records while a person reviews exceptions before use.

assumptions: The boundary starts with a received complaint and ends with a recorded outcome or named escalation.

The complaint contract contains customer ID, account ID, received timestamp, complaint category, requested remedy, source event IDs, urgency, outcome and corrective-action owner; the customer and case systems provide the fields.
Unmatched identity, safety concern or formal legal escalation is routed to the appropriate human owner.
Native CRM complaint cases and escalation rules are tested before a custom flow.
Two hours per 100 focal-role baseline hours are allowed for taxonomy changes and recurring escalation review.
unknowns: Which remedies a loan officer may offer without approval.
What response deadlines apply to the lender's complaint process.
research_questions: Which complaint categories recur most often?
How often does a complaint require a remedy beyond the officer's authority?

already_counted.description: Officer review of triage and evidence timeline

incremental.description: Maintain complaint taxonomy and review escalations

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Most complaint work remains investigation and a live remedy conversation; two upkeep hours per 100 baseline hours are deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep current on new loan types and financial services relevant to customers.

steps.what: Receive approved product notices, policy changes and market-service updates
Read a changed product or service and compare it with the needs and cases the officer sees

loop.output: change summary, affected customer situations and source links
loop.check: the officer reads the original notice and marks any uncertain interpretation
loop.stop: stop when a notice changes eligibility, pricing or policy without a clear approved explanation; ask the product owner
loop.why_not_simpler: A feed can collect notices, but relevance to customer situations needs professional judgement.

steps.what: Update the personal knowledge note and ask a product owner about unresolved implications
Share a materially changed customer explanation or referral trigger with the team

tasks.design: An approved-content queue in {DOCS} groups notices by product and effective date and provides a source-linked change summary. The loan officer judges relevance, asks the product owner where necessary and shares only settled guidance with colleagues.
tasks.previous_blocker: Updates arrive through scattered notices and each officer decides alone what they mean for customer conversations.
tasks.enabler_now: A knowledge queue can collect approved notices and show them against product and effective date.
tasks.still_hard: A change can affect suitability, eligibility or customer explanation in ways that require a responsible professional reading.
tasks.human_edge: The officer connects an abstract product change to the actual questions and circumstances seen in client conversations.

ambition.what: Maintain a source-linked team learning queue for changes that alter customer explanations or referral triggers.

tasks.altitude: The officer identifies gaps in product guidance rather than merely consuming notices.

reach.task: Clarify the customer impact of an approved product change
reach.learn: Frame a question with a real customer scenario and cited source notice.

evidence.claim: The digest identifies approved templates and source documents as suitable inputs for bounded drafting and review.

assumptions: The boundary starts with an approved product or policy notice and ends with a personal or team learning item, not changed product policy.

The learning contract contains notice ID, product ID, effective date, source link, stated change, affected customer situation, unresolved question and owner; product owners publish the source notices.
Unapproved or ambiguous information stays in the question queue rather than being shared as guidance.
Native document subscriptions and knowledge features are tested before a custom answer desk.
One hour per 100 focal-role baseline hours is allowed for source-feed maintenance and stale-content review.
unknowns: Who approves interpretations of product changes for customer-facing use.
How quickly new terms must reach officers after publication.
research_questions: Which updates most often trigger officer questions?
How often does a product notice change a customer referral path?

already_counted.description: Officer reading and relevance review of changed notices

incremental.description: Maintain approved-source feed and retire stale summaries

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Understanding and sharing a material change remains human work; one upkeep hour per 100 baseline hours is deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Market relevant bank services to individuals and firms.

steps.what: Identify existing customers or firms with a permitted contact basis and a relevant service trigger
Prepare a factual contact brief using approved product content and the known customer context

loop.input: approved content, contact permission and customer context
loop.output: factual contact brief with source links and exclusions
loop.check: the officer checks permission, product accuracy and that the brief makes no suitability claim
loop.stop: stop on missing permission, uncertain eligibility or an unapproved claim; do not contact the customer
loop.why_not_simpler: The content is controlled but the relevance and safe wording depend on the contact context.

steps.what: Speak with the individual or firm, discover needs and offer only appropriate next information
Log the outcome, opt-out or follow-up task against the contact record

tasks.design: A {CRM} view uses permitted contact data and approved service triggers to prepare a factual contact brief. The loan officer conducts the needs conversation and the {WORKFLOW} records outcomes, opt-outs and follow-up without treating a prospect score as a decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Officers search past contact notes and product pages, then manually record each outreach result.
tasks.enabler_now: Permission fields, approved content and outcome logging can be joined in a controlled contact workflow.
tasks.still_hard: A genuine need, appropriate timing and a useful conversation cannot be inferred from a contact list.
tasks.human_edge: The officer can build trust, recognise that a service is not relevant and respect a customer's refusal.

ambition.what: Give small firms with a stated service trigger a timely human conversation rather than a generic campaign message.

tasks.altitude: The officer examines which triggers produce useful conversations and improves the approved contact playbook.

reach.task: Qualify a permissioned service enquiry and record a useful next step
reach.learn: Separate an approved factual offer from a suitability claim.

evidence.claim: Approved content and a bounded draft can support preparation, but the financial-service conversation remains human judgement.

assumptions: The boundary starts with a permitted service trigger and ends with a logged contact outcome, not a product sale or credit decision.

The contact contract contains customer or firm ID, permission status, contact channel, service trigger, product-content version, contact date, outcome, opt-out state and follow-up owner; the CRM supplies the contact fields.
An absent permission or unclear eligibility blocks outreach and is not overridden by the workflow.
Native CRM segments, preferences and tasks are tested before custom contact automation.
One hour per 100 focal-role baseline hours is allowed for trigger review, content updates and opt-out exceptions.
unknowns: Which contact permissions and channels are available for each customer group.
Which services can be discussed without a separate suitability or credit process.
research_questions: Which service triggers lead to a useful customer conversation?
How often do contacts opt out or ask for a different channel?

already_counted.description: Officer review of prepared contact brief

incremental.description: Review service triggers, content updates and opt-out exceptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The needs conversation remains the main work; one upkeep hour per 100 baseline hours is deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Run a daily exception review across incomplete applications, credit evidence and authority routes.
reach: personal financial advisor: recognise when an applicant needs broader budgeting or debt advice
role.ambitious_version: Give more applicants a complete, understandable path from enquiry to an accountable lending decision.
